verdict.rationale: Synctera documents parts of this story. KYC/KYB results are recorded as verification objects, which can show why an application is not cleared. Customers can have documentation verified, and EDD lets the fintech submit additional information on high-risk customers for AML review. A centralized operations platform is also claimed for collaboration with the bank partner. missing for 10: an explicit onboarding queue view with pending-reason codes, a documented document-upload flow tied to pending applications, a clear delineation of which decisions belong to the fintech versus the bank, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can work the onboarding queue — see why an application is pending, supply additional documents, and understand which decisions are mine versus the bank's

citations.quote: runs identity and watchlist checks for personal and business customers and records the results as `verification` objects
Enhanced due diligence (EDD) lets you submit additional information about high-risk customers, businesses, accounts, and transactions to support anti-money-laundering review
Manage all operational workflows in a centralized platform with a set of tools that provide complete data visibility and seamless collaboration between you and your bank partner.
